subtitles.en: look at the risk on environment, we're certainly feeling that in our own stock greatest foreign interest, we've seen in the ROI stock in quite some time. So
subtitles.zh: 传统业务需求旺盛，同时新兴技术如太空和卫星领域也备受关注。

subtitles.en: there's a hunger for traditional businesses, but then to your point, these emerging technologies in space and satellites
subtitles.zh: 对AI、计算能力和存储能力的推动，催生了对各种资本（债务和权益）的无限渴求。

subtitles.en: absolutely, the push for AI and capacity, compute capacity, memory capacity, it's driving a insatiable appetite for all forms of capital debt and equity.
subtitles.zh: 无论是寻求借款的公司还是希望入场的市场参与者，需求都无止境。感觉像是一场竞赛。为什么？

subtitles.en: It's insatiable both on the part of the company's looking to borrow, as well as the investors looking to get in. It feels like there's this race. Why?
subtitles.zh: 无论是寻求借款的公司，还是希望参与的市场参与者，都表现出无法满足的渴望。这就像一场竞赛。为什么？
